what: khách sạn Hải Âu, the hotel Hải Âu at 124 Hạ Long, in front of the jetty of Cầu Đá
uses: Plan 0026, R7, Q7, Q8: on its OSM outline (way 790529523) by Hạ Long; PT-74 takes a screenshot of it. In place of its stand-in.

photos.author: trungydang
photos.shows: Khách sạn Hải Âu (124 Hạ Long) from the road: sky blue walls with white bands, a middle block of six storeys under a curved canopy with the red letters HAI AU, a stair tower of glass, a left wing of five storeys with round balconies and the green sign HOTEL HẢI ÂU, a right wing of five storeys with long bands of windows and its top floor set back, shops and a porch on the ground floor, pots of plants, a Norfolk pine.

photos.author: HappyMidnight
photos.shows: Khách sạn Hải Âu in 2010: the same blocks, white with light green panels, white letters HAI AU on the canopy.

photos.date: on or before 2019-01 (the date of the image file on the server)
photos.author: Viet Fun Travel
photos.shows: Khách sạn Hải Âu light blue with white trim, about five stepped storeys with curved balcony fronts, big red letters HAI AU on the roof.

checks: Views: front (from Hạ Long), three quarters, far (from the walk of the sea 150 m away).
The middle block has six storeys and the wings five; the right wing has its top floor set back.
The walls are sky blue with white bands at the floors (the look of the photo of 2014, Q7).
The red letters HAI AU on the curved canopy over the middle block (Q8: Hải Âu stood in 2019, and its name is used).
No sign of a bank or of another brand.
